'''2011 German National Championship Gosse Zeilstra LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Gosse Zeilstra]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hidden Base Ewoks
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
